scope: Interpretation of existing bounded one-time migration authorization; no process or source approval claimed
decision: Existing approved worker-owned migration may run concurrently with controller/cooperative-helper source review. Independent reviewed new helper is required before RESUME; source review of every one-time migration command was not an express prior requirement.
necessary_conditions: Positive exact process/start/command/cwd and safe wait-state/pipe ownership
No live curl interruption; actual natural outcomes and stdout/stderr/body retained
No blind resumption of obsolete reader after stdout ownership transfer
No queued or dormant successor writer at complete native-worker handoff
Actual independent host corroboration and reviewed controller before lifecycle release
Reviewed replacement helper, durable resume reservation, actual same-agent WAIT-only followup, ACK and explicit grant before resumed writes
host_action: Withdraw added all-source-PASS-before-any-migration sequencing; retain all original migration conditions and lifecycle gates.
not_performed_by_reviewer: source approval inferred from prior review
